address: No. 17, 39 Hongji Middle Road, Jinjiang, Chengdu, China Mainland
bio: A quaint mansion obscured by a big tree is home to this restaurant run by the Woos. The cosy space shows hints of nostalgia; both cold appetisers and hot mains are based on tradition, but fine-tuned and modernised. The fried wild-caught yellow croaker in a mound of fried chillies has silky, moist flesh; with its bold flavour, it goes perfectly with alcohol. The sweet sticky rice dumplings with a runny filling round off your meal nicely....
